messages.subject: hello !! I need your help
parts:
i would  like  to know the difference between specification model zeroinflatedpoisson1 and zeroinflatedpoisson0 models. How can I determine overdispersion? I am modeling deaths due to severe malaria. I have the target population and have calculated the expected deaths by taking the national case fatality rates and multiplying them by the presumed cases plus the confirmed cases to obtain the expected deaths. I also have covariates related to anti-malaria interventions and other contextual variables. I would like to know how to use the offset and E in the inla() function in general and in my specific case.
this is  my formula : formula_pois_zeroinfl <- Nombre_deces_imputed ~ 1 +
  f(Numero_DS, model = "bym2", graph = g, constr = TRUE,scale.model = TRUE) +  # Effet spatial BYM2
  f(Mois, model = "ar1")+
  f(inter_id,model="iid") +# Effet fixe pour les mois
  log(TDR_P)+Mois+Annee1+Region+
  log(ACT)+RMAT + proportion_pop_Access_MII_5km +
   proportion_pop_Use_MII_5km+proportion_pauvre+log(densite_pop)+
  log(Ratio_habitant_csps)+moins_5km+plus_5km+cas_TDR+
  ca_micros+Cas_Confirmes_moins_5ans+Cas_Presumes_moins_5ans
and  my model is :model_pois_zeroinfl <- inla(formula_pois_zeroinfl,
                            family = "zeroinflatedpoisson1",  # Poisson gonflé à zéro
                            data = dohio,
                            offset =log(dohio$pop_cible),
                            #E= dohio$E,# Exposition
                            control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                            control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE,waic=TRUE),
                            control.fixed = list(mean = 0, prec = 0.001)
)

# Résumé du modèle

summary(model_pois_zeroinfl)
I don't understood also  the priors  in my  model.
thanks you
